verdict.rationale: monday.com's own docs say you can create custom dashboard widgets and board views through its apps framework. Its marketing claims automated status and performance reports and detection of progress gaps, which together support reporting on project progress. However, the widget evidence is developer-oriented, and nothing documents a native, no-code dashboard builder for a PM. Missing for 10: documented PM-facing native dashboard and widget builder, specifics of the available progress-reporting widgets, independent or hands-on corroboration.
